desc.join: become a member of this neighbourhood
desc.search: find things to borrow and people who can help
desc.remove: take down your item or skill
desc.profile: what a neighbour lends and can do
desc.vote: vote to switch Red Sky (crisis mode) on or off
desc.account: set up a login for the app

text.help_footer: Photos, reviews, invites and settings work in the app: {url}
text.unknown: I don't know that one. Send {help} for the list.
text.group_not_linked: This group is not linked to a NeighbourGood community yet. An admin or leader can link it in the app.
text.not_member: You're not a member yet. Send !{join} YourName in your neighbourhood group.
text.dm_unknown: Hi, I'm the NeighbourGood bot. Join in your neighbourhood group with !{join} YourName, or link your app account with the code from Settings.
text.join_need_name: Please add the name your neighbours know you by, e.g. !{join} Anna
text.join_done: Welcome {name}, you're now a member of {community}. I only store your WhatsApp ID and this name.
text.join_dm_hint: Write me privately once so I can tell you when someone wants to borrow from you: {link}
text.join_other: You're already a member of another community. Leave it in the app first.
text.linked_user: Your WhatsApp is now linked to {name}.
text.linked_group: This group is now linked to {community}. Send !{help} to see what I can do.
text.link_invalid: That code is invalid or expired. Create a new one in the app.
text.link_taken: This WhatsApp number already belongs to another account.
text.missing_text: Please write what you mean after the command, e.g. {example}
text.lend_done: Listed *{title}* as #{id}. Add a photo in the app: {url}
text.need_done: Posted your request *{title}*. Neighbours will see it.
text.borrow_no_dm: {owner} hasn't written to me privately yet, so they'll see your request in the app.
text.booking_request_dm: {borrower} would like to borrow *{title}* ({start} – {end}). Reply {yes} {id} or {no} {id}.
text.date_invalid: I couldn't read the dates. Write them like 24.12. 27.12. or 2026-12-24 2026-12-27.
text.mine_empty: You haven't shared or requested anything yet.
text.sos_done: Emergency request #{id} sent to your neighbours. Stay safe.
text.ping_needs_red: Pings only work in Red Sky mode. Use {sos} instead.
text.status_blue: {community} is in Blue Sky (normal) mode. Open emergency requests: {count}.
text.status_red: {community} is in *Red Sky* (crisis) mode. Open emergency requests: {count}.
text.vote_done: Your vote is counted: {votes} of {needed} needed.
text.vote_red: Red Sky (crisis mode) is now on for {community}.
text.vote_blue: {community} is back in Blue Sky (normal) mode.
text.account_link: Open this link within an hour to set an email and password for your account: {url}
text.account_full: You already have an app account. Log in at {url}
text.private_only: Please write me privately for that: {link}
text.stop_done: Private messages are off. Send {start} to turn them on again.
text.delete_confirm: This deletes your NeighbourGood data (items, skills, requests). To confirm, send {delete} {code}
text.delete_done: Your data has been deleted. Goodbye.
text.delete_full: Your account has an app login. Delete it in the app under Settings: {url}
text.err_forbidden: You're not allowed to do that.
text.group_red: *RED SKY*: {community} has switched to crisis mode. Ask for help with !{sos} <what you need>, see the situation with !{status}.
text.group_blue: {community} is back in Blue Sky (normal) mode.
text.crisis_dm: {community} is now in Red Sky (crisis) mode.
text.ticket_assigned_dm: An emergency request was assigned to you: *{title}*.
text.digest_footer: Search with !{search} <word> · more in the app: {url}
